change_summary: ExtractedFieldEntry.source_span changed from Optional[str]=None to required str with min_length=1, so span-less LLM output fails parsing and triggers retry tiers instead of flowing downstream. Output contract ExtractedField.source_span stays Optional; validator still flags span-less fields with needs_review.

issue: Issue 2: plain-prompt fallback drops document and rules (high)
change_summary: Attempt 3 repair prompt now embeds the original extraction request (document text + catalog + never-guess/source_span rules) alongside the broken fragment and schema, so the repair stays grounded.

issue: Issue 3: 'invent a name' encourages fabricated new fields (medium)
change_summary: Closed by the Issue 9 evidence gate: an invented name is only registered when its source_span verifies against the document text (check_evidence clean). Invented-but-unverifiable names are refused with an evidence reason.

Old: unordered token overlap >= 0.75 accepted for spans of any length. New: short spans (<=3 tokens) must be a contiguous normalized substring with no overlap fallback; longer spans keep the 0.75 overlap fallback for OCR noise only.

issue: Issue 5: empty document text disables evidence checking (high)
change_summary: check_evidence now returns a 'no document text to verify against (possible hallucination)' problem when document_text is empty/None and the field carries a value, instead of falling through to pass.

Removed the is_image_extraction early-return bypass; spans are always verified against OCR text when text exists (parameter kept for caller compatibility). Empty-text image case is covered by the Issue 5 flag.

issue: Issue 7: validator checks serialized blob, not array rows (high)
change_summary: Added per-row evidence check (_check_array_rows): JSON-serialized array field values are parsed and each row's text is verified against the document (substring or 0.75 token overlap); first unverifiable row yields a validation error + needs_review. Field itself is never dropped.

Skip now additionally requires every numeric field's source_span to be a contiguous substring of the page text (_all_numeric_spans_verbatim); non-verbatim numeric spans always get a judge review. Judge prompt now includes per-field source_spans (provenance block) so it can verify provenance, not just values.

issue: Issue 9: hallucinated names permanently written to catalog (high)
change_summary: Registration gate now requires check_evidence clean when document_text is provided (both production paths pass page_text) and raises the effective bar from max(configured, 0.6) to max(configured, 0.8) via NEW_FIELD_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR. Refusals are reported in skipped with reasons, never silent.

issue: Issue 10: validation flags but never blocks (medium)
change_summary: Deferred: proper fix needs an ExtractionResult quarantine/audit field (schema + service + Temporal + frontend contract change) so rejected values stop shipping in .fields without being silently dropped. Current flag behavior (validation_errors + needs_review=True) retained.
